providers.compliance_boundary: Use official/public pages and user-provided URLs. Do not bypass login, paywalls, robots restrictions, or rate limits.
Use only public frontdoor metadata or user-provided links by default. Downloading, clipping, or reuse requires rights/privacy review.
Treat comments/accounts as sensitive. Mask identities and keep only minimal evidence needed for review. Crawling is isolated and disabled by default.
Use checked-in examples when live internet or rights-cleared media are unavailable. Mark discovery_mode as offline_fixture.
